_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "layers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_argb" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_visible" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_visible" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'circles', "is_inverted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_inverted" IN (0, 1)), "opacity" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "border_level" TEXT NULL, "border_fill_areas" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("border_fill_areas" IN (0, 1)), "border_show_names" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("border_show_names" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "circles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "layer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES layers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "center_lat" REAL NOT NULL, "center_lng" REAL NOT NULL, "radius_meters" REAL NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "planes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "layer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES layers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "a_lat" REAL NOT NULL, "a_lng" REAL NOT NULL, "b_lat" REAL NOT NULL, "b_lng" REAL NOT NULL, "near_a" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("near_a" IN (0, 1)), "label" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "uncertainty_meters" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 500.0, "last_lat" REAL NULL, "last_lng" REAL NULL, "last_zoom" REAL NULL, "transport_overlay" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("transport_overlay" IN (0, 1)), "transit_endpoint" TEXT NULL, "poi_categories" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "border_levels" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tools_expanded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("tools_expanded" IN (0, 1)), "basemap_visible" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("basemap_visible" IN (0, 1)), "basemap_opacity" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subspaces" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "layer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES layers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "label" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subspace_points" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "subspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subspaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "lat" REAL NOT NULL, "lng" REAL NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_main" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_main" IN (0, 1)), "label" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "free_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "layer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES layers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "label" TEXT NULL, "offset_meters" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "inclusion_lat" REAL NULL, "inclusion_lng" REAL NULL, "inclusion_radius_meters" REAL NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "free_line_points" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "free_line_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES free_lines (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "lat" REAL NOT NULL, "lng" REAL NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "free_areas" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "layer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES layers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "label" TEXT NULL, "offset_meters" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "free_area_points" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "free_area_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES free_areas (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "lat" REAL NOT NULL, "lng" REAL NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "height_regions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "layer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES layers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "center_lat" REAL NOT NULL, "center_lng" REAL NOT NULL, "radius_meters" REAL NOT NULL, "threshold_meters" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "above_threshold" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("above_threshold" IN (0, 1)), "sample_zoom" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 13, "label" TEXT NULL, "generated_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "height_polygons" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "height_region_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES height_regions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "height_polygon_points" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "polygon_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES height_polygons (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "lat" REAL NOT NULL, "lng" REAL NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "poi_sets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "layer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES layers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "category_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "center_lat" REAL NOT NULL, "center_lng" REAL NOT NULL, "radius_meters" REAL NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "poi_points" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "poi_set_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES poi_sets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "lat" REAL NOT NULL, "lng" REAL NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "osm_type" TEXT NULL, "osm_id" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transit_sets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "layer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES layers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "south" REAL NOT NULL, "west" REAL NOT NULL, "north" REAL NOT NULL, "east" REAL NOT NULL, "mode_mask" INTEGER NOT NULL, "visible_mode_mask" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "label" TEXT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "station_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "node_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transit_stops" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "set_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transit_sets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "osm_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lat" REAL NOT NULL, "lng" REAL NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "mode_mask" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "node_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "route_ref" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "border_sets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "layer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES layers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "south" REAL NOT NULL, "west" REAL NOT NULL, "north" REAL NOT NULL, "east" REAL NOT NULL, "admin_level" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "area_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "point_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "border_areas" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "set_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES border_sets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "osm_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "color_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "south" REAL NOT NULL, "west" REAL NOT NULL, "north" REAL NOT NULL, "east" REAL NOT NULL, "label_lat" REAL NOT NULL, "label_lng" REAL NOT NULL, "point_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rings" TEXT NOT NULL, "way_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tile_cache" ("url" TEXT NOT NULL, "bytes" BLOB NOT NULL, "etag" TEXT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_used_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("url"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "overpass_cache" ("kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "south" REAL NOT NULL, "west" REAL NOT NULL, "north" REAL NOT NULL, "east" REAL NOT NULL, "mask_bits" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("kind"));
